ko.executive_summary: MediaTek launched the Dimensity 9600 Pro, its first 2nm smartphone chip built on TSMC's process, extending TSMC's competitive lead in advanced node smartphone SoCs. Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 may shift to Samsung foundry, signaling potential diversification in flagship mobile chip sourcing.
key_facts: MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro using TSMC 2nm process
TSMC securing MediaTek orders pressures Samsung and Qualcomm
Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 potentially using Samsung chipmaking
Fujifilm announcing Rs. 800 Crore semiconductor materials facility in India
Samsung restructuring Cheonan Complex to prioritize HBM production

implications.text: TSMC's established 2nm yield and reliability make it the default choice for flagship mobile SoCs; competitors Samsung and Qualcomm face margin pressure.
MediaTek's move to 2nm signals aggressive challenge to Qualcomm Snapdragon flagship positioning; design wins at 2nm critical for mid-to-premium tier phones.
Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 sourcing shift to Samsung suggests Qualcomm exploring multi-foundry strategy to reduce dependency and improve terms.

ko.counterpoint: Samsung's 2nm readiness and design support capability remain uncertain; execution delays could favor continued TSMC concentration.
